content: In Table 3 , we examine the robustness of the sentiment models under each attack and defense method. In the absence of any attack or defense, BERT (a word-piece model) performs the best ( $90.3\%$ ) followed by word+char models ( $80.5\%$ ), word-only models ( $79.2\%$ ) and then char-only models ( $70.3\%$ ). However, even single-character attacks (chosen adversarially) can be catastrophic, resulting in a significantly degraded performance of $46\%$ , $57\%$ , $59\%$ and $33\%$ , respectively under the `all' setting.
